conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Hello, I want to know if my loan application got approved. It’s been weeks!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Good morning Sir. Could you share your application ID or full name to check the status?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: It’s Manav Gupta. I don’t have any ID number. The branch didn’t give me one.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: No problem. I’ve found your application. It’s approved, but we need your KYC documents to proceed.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: KYC? What’s that? Why didn’t anyone tell me?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I’m sorry for the oversight. KYC means identity verification. I’ll send you a list of required documents via SMS.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Okay, please send it soon. I need the loan urgently.
